Pembina County North Dakota Inmate Lookup

Finding information about an inmate in Pembina County, North Dakota requires knowing where to look and what resources are available to the public. A pembina county north dakota inmate lookup can be conducted through several official channels, including the Pembina County Sheriff's Office and the North Dakota Department of Corrections. This guide provides comprehensive information about searching for inmates, understanding the bail process, visitation policies, and what happens after an arrest in Pembina County.

How to Search Pembina County Jail Records

  1. Visit the Pembina County Sheriff's Office website or call their main administrative line to inquire about inmate search services. Many county facilities maintain searchable databases that are accessible to the public during business hours.
  2. Gather basic information about the person you are searching for, including their full name, date of birth, and the approximate date of arrest. Having accurate details will help narrow down search results.
  3. Use the official inmate locator tools provided by the Pembina County Sheriff's Office. These databases typically allow you to search by name, booking number, or arrest date.
  4. If the person is not found in county records, expand your search to the North Dakota Department of Corrections database, as they may have been transferred to a state facility.
  5. For federal charges, search the Federal Bureau of Prisons Inmate Locator, which maintains records of all individuals in federal custody nationwide.
  6. Check local court records through the Pembina County District Court to verify arrest dates, charges, and court appearance schedules.
  7. Document the booking number and facility location once you locate the inmate, as this information will be needed for visitation, communication, and bail arrangements.

Bail Bond Information for Pembina County

When someone is arrested in Pembina County, bail may be set at their initial appearance before a judge. A bail bond allows a defendant to be released from custody pending trial by paying a percentage of the total bail amount. In North Dakota, most bail bondsmen charge a standard fee of 10% of the total bail amount, which is non-refundable regardless of the case outcome. For example, if bail is set at $5,000, a bail bondsman fee would typically be $500. The defendant or their family can contact a licensed bail bondsman in Pembina County to arrange the bond and secure the inmate's release.

The arraignment typically occurs within 24 to 72 hours of arrest, at which time the judge reviews the charges and sets bail conditions. It is important to act quickly during this window, as remaining in custody longer than necessary can complicate employment, housing, and family responsibilities. Having contact information for local bail bond companies readily available can expedite the process. Some bail bondsmen in the Pembina County area work with families directly and may offer payment plans or accept collateral in lieu of full payment upfront.

Visitation Rules at Pembina County Jail

  • Inmate Identification: You must have the inmate's full name and booking number when scheduling or arriving for a visit.
  • Visitation Hours: Most county jails in North Dakota operate visitation during specific windows; contact the facility directly to confirm exact hours, as they vary by day of the week.
  • Dress Code: Visitors are expected to dress modestly and professionally. Clothing that is revealing, contains gang-related symbols, or appears disruptive will not be permitted.
  • Video Visitation: Many facilities now offer video visitation as an alternative to in-person visits, allowing family members to connect remotely through secured systems.
  • Children Policy: Children may be permitted to visit but must be supervised at all times and must follow all facility rules. Some facilities restrict children under a certain age.
  • Contact Restrictions: Inmates may have visitation restrictions imposed by court order or jail administration based on the nature of charges or behavior.

What to Expect After Arrest in Pembina County

  1. Booking Process: The arrested individual will be brought to the Pembina County Jail where personal information, charges, and details about the arrest are recorded. Belongings are inventoried and stored securely.
  2. Medical Screening: All new inmates undergo a medical screening to identify health conditions, medications, and mental health concerns that may require attention during incarceration.
  3. Classification and Housing: Based on the severity of charges, criminal history, and behavior during booking, the inmate is classified and assigned to appropriate housing within the facility.
  4. Arraignment Appearance: Within the required timeframe, the inmate appears before a judge for arraignment, where charges are read, rights are explained, and bail is determined.
  5. Facility Transfer: If bail is not posted or if the charges are serious, the inmate may be transferred to a state correctional facility or another jurisdiction for holding.

How to Contact Pembina County Jail

To obtain information about an inmate or to arrange visitation, contact the Pembina County Jail directly through the sheriff's office. Staff can provide inmate status updates, booking information, and details about visitation schedules and procedures. Having the person's full name and approximate arrest date will help expedite your inquiry.
